tables.description: List of rainbow table names to use. Format per item is 'table_name[,a[,b,...]]' as specified by the -t option.

tables_dir.description: Base directory where rainbow tables are stored, specified by the -d option.

input_file.description: Path to the file containing hashes to crack (pwdump or session format), specified by the -f option.

output_file.description: Path to write cracking output in pwdump format, specified by the -o option.

log_file.description: Path to log all output to. If not set or empty, no log file is created. Specified by the -l option.

threads.description: Number of threads to use for cracking. Specified by the -n option.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output. Specified by the -v option.

bruteforce.description: Enable bruteforce mode. Specified by the -B option. Default is enabled.

audit_mode.description: Enable audit mode. Specified by the -A option.

hide_usernames.description: Hide usernames in output. Specified by the -i option. Default is to show usernames (-I).

show_stats.description: Display statistics when cracking ends. Specified by the -u option.

no_empty_passwords.description: Do not display empty passwords. Specified by the -e option.

no_session_autosave.description: Disable session auto-saving. Specified by the -s option.

export_csv.description: Export data in CSV format to the file specified by -o. Specified by the -x option.

session_file.description: File to use to automatically save the progress of the search. Specified by the -S option.

debug.description: Display lots of debugging information. Specified by the -D option.

launch_on_start.description: Launch the cracking when ophcrack starts. GUI only. Specified by the -r option.

sam_dir.description: Directory to load hashes from encrypted SAM file. Specified by the -w option.
